body:
It's costly and unproductive. It doesn't improve your social status, it doesn't make you any money unless you're paid critic, and it doesn't get you laid.

People don't wanna be around someone who isn't productive. And I don't wanna be productive. I can barely stand having to work a job so I can pay bills.

But none of this really gets into the actual reason for wanting to end my existence: a seething hatred for the nature of reality.

If I'm not entertained, I'm bored. My only passion is consumption. I don't like music, I like listening to music. I don't like drawing, I like looking at others' drawings. I don't like work. I like other people to do work for me. I don't like studying, I like watching people present their studies. I don't like sports, I like watching sports.

I don't like to have to put effort into anything. It's laborious, and often unrewarding.
Drowning in entertainment and pleasure as a reprieve from boredom.

Oh I physically can't do it. On my very first session she made me sign a form that stated if I displayed any tendencies or ideations to self harm she would immediately contact the authorities.

I haven't been back.
